{"metadata":{"description":"A customized DeepSeek Harness filesystem UI plugin.","id":"gh:1335024435","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-client-ui-filesystem","slug":"dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-filesystem","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A customized DeepSeek Harness filesystem UI plugin."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# ui-filesystem"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** · 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A dsh plugin that adds **`@` project file/directory suggestions** to the chat composer: type `@` to "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"browse the current project (the session's working directory), pick a file or directory, and the draf"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"t gains a `@path` reference that ships to the model verbatim."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Built as a fully out-of-tree plugin — the deepseek-harness source stays untouched. It rides the same"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" input-trigger pipeline as ui-skill's `/` (so it coexists with ui-subagent's `@` mentions as a secon"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"d menu group), and it serves its project tree over its own HTTP route (`ctx.webServer`)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. Install the plugin from npm (published as `@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-filesystem`):"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The package declares `dsh.bundle` (its bundled `cordis.patch.yml`), so `dsh plugin add` automaticall"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"y appends it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer stack and the plugin mounts on the next bo"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ot — **no manual `cordis.patch.yml` editing**."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Upgrading an install that predates the bundle declaration: remove the legacy `ui-filesystem` row fro"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"m `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle layer now supplies it, and leaving both "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"would mount the id twice."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"2. Restart the profile (new plugins are discovered at boot), open any session, and type `@`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Building from source (development / offline)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **`@` trigger**: same pipeline as ui-skill's `/` (`ui-input-trigger`), shown alongside ui-subagent"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"'s `@` mentions as its own menu group
- **Basename-prefix matching**: the query matches only the fil"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e/directory **name** prefix, never the path prefix — `@index` hits `src/index.ts` and `test/index.ts"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"`; path-shaped queries like `@src/` return nothing (by design)
- **Filename-first rows**: every cand"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"idate shows the file/directory name first and the relative path after (e.g. `index.ts  src/index.ts`"},{"id":"p15s6","text":")
- **Plain-text references**: picking replaces the `@` token with the literal `@relative/path ` — t"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"he prompt ships the same literal and the model resolves the file with its own fs tools
- **Per-sessi"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"on caching**: each session fetches the bounded project tree once; keystroke filtering happens locall"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"y, and `connection/reset` rebuilds the cache
- **Bounded walk**: skips `node_modules` / `.git` / hid"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"den entries (configurable), caps depth at 6 and entries at 2000, and never lists symlinks
- **Retry "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"on failure**: a failed tree request (e.g. right after the host restarts, before the session is attac"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"hed) retries once, keeping the menu in its loading state instead of vanishing"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Usage notes (harness behavior, accepted as-is)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Where `@` triggers**: the trigger char must sit at the start of the draft, after whitespace, or "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"after punctuation. A Chinese character directly before `@` does **not** trigger (`请查看@index` is a mi"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ss; `请查看，@index` works) — the trigger detector treats CJK letters as word characters. That rule live"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"s in the harness's `ui-input-trigger`; this plugin does not modify the harness, so inline references"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" work best with a space or punctuation before `@`.
- **Loading state**: while the project tree loads"},{"id":"p17s6","text":", the menu opens immediately with the group's existing text-only loading row (`正在加载…`); an animated "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"spinner would require modifying the harness menu component, which this plugin does not do.
- **No ch"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ip decoration**: `@path` stays plain text in the draft — the decoration scanner only matches word-is"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"h names, so paths never render as chips (DESIGN.md §7.1).
- **No menu group title**: the harness men"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"u renders a raw per-source title row (the `slash.menu` dictionary is exclusively owned by the harnes"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"s); since `@` shows only this plugin's group, the title row is hidden with one injected CSS rule.
- "},{"id":"p17s12","text":"Full boundary list: `DESIGN.md` §7."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Verify"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The composed config shows the `ui-filesystem` row, and `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json` list"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"s `@dsh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-filesystem` under `dsh.profile.bundles` (auto-appended by `dsh plugin a"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"sh-mixxed/dsh-client-ui-filesystem` under `dsh.profile.bundles` (auto-appended by `dsh plugin add`)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"After the restart: `@` opens the `filesystem` group (name first, path after) → basename-prefix filte"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ring → picking inserts `@path ` → the model can read the file from the prompt literal."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Config (optional)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Tune the walk bounds from your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` — the user layer is applied after th"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"e bundle layer, so an id-targeted patch overrides the bundled mount row:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
